name: justtshtml
description: Dependency-free TypeScript HTML5 parser (browser + Node.js + Bun). TypeScript port of justjshtml / JustHTML, targeting full html5lib-tests conformance.
author: Arthur Souza Rodrigues <arthur@jandira.tech>

scripts.test:html5lib: bun run scripts/smoke.ts && bun run scripts/run-selector-tests.ts && bun run scripts/run-stream-tests.ts && bun run scripts/run-markdown-tests.ts && bun run scripts/run-encoding-tests.ts && bun run scripts/run-tokenizer-tests.ts && bun run scripts/run-tree-construction-tests.ts && bun run scripts/run-serializer-tests.ts
scripts.coverage: c8 --include 'src/**' --exclude 'src/entities-data.ts' --reporter=text-summary --reporter=text --reporter=html bash -c 'tsx scripts/smoke.ts > /dev/null && tsx scripts/run-selector-tests.ts > /dev/null && tsx scripts/run-stream-tests.ts > /dev/null && tsx scripts/run-markdown-tests.ts > /dev/null && tsx scripts/run-encoding-tests.ts > /dev/null && tsx scripts/run-tokenizer-tests.ts > /dev/null && tsx scripts/run-tree-construction-tests.ts > /dev/null && tsx scripts/run-serializer-tests.ts > /dev/null'
